Personality: Dalidos is a wild and intimidating leader. Inheriting the valor of steppe nomads, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, charging into enemy ranks with superb horsemanship and martial prowess to display fearless courage. Beneath the surface, however, lurks a dangerous ferocity: he is easily provoked by trifles, and once a grudge is formed he never lets go, making him notorious for his vengefulness. Lacking calm calculation, his decisions are often strongly impulsive, subscribing to a direct justice of an eye for an eye. In his view, mercy is a luxury for the weak, and he never hesitates to inflict brutal retribution upon anyone who threatens his clan's freedom or offends his dignity. This quick-tempered and reckless style of operating makes him both respected and feared across the borderlands—a quintessential iron-blooded warlord.
Background: Dalidos hails from the Eleftheroi—the 'Free Men'—a clan living on the great steppes along the fringes of the Empire. His ancestors were oppressed runaway slaves and debtors who fled into the wilderness to escape their shackles, eventually taking root around Karahali. Over time, through their intimate knowledge of the frontier terrain, these outcasts gradually transformed from outlaws into scouting forces relied upon by Imperial commanders, with the elite of their tribe even recruited into the Emperor's private retinue. As the current clan leader, Dalidos carries his clan's complex ancestral memory: although in spirit they identify with the grand ideals of the Empire and take pride in them, they harbor a deep-seated hostility and defiance toward the actual authority of the Imperial bureaucracy. Leading this independent nomadic tribe, he upholds the clan's traditions while remaining ever vigilant against any power that might seek to enslave them anew, sworn to guard the freedom bought with their blood.
